source_text_en: If the AMF indicates active time value to the UE, AMF should not indicate "all PLMN registration area allocated" indication in the MICO indication IE to the UE.
gold_condition: if the AMF indicates an active-time value to the UE
extracted_condition: If the AMF indicates active time value to the UE
gold_action: indicate 'all PLMN registration area allocated' in the MICO indication IE
extracted_action: indicate "all PLMN registration area allocated" indication in the MICO indication IE to the UE
reviewer_note: AMF·active-time 통지 조건·MICO IE all-PLMN 표시 동작이 해당 슬롯에 정확하고 discouragement/negative도 일치.

source_text_en: Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF may be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs.
gold_actor: each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF, and W-AGF
extracted_actor: Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF
gold_action: be configured with a TAI value different from or the same as the value of the other listed access functions
extracted_action: be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs
reviewer_note: 네 access 기능과 동일/상이 TAI 구성 대안 모두 보존. 조건·예외 추가 없음.

source_text_en: When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF, the target AMF includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived (see subclause 9.11.2.6).
gold_condition: when a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K_AMF
extracted_condition: When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF
gold_action: be derived
extracted_action: includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived
gold_exception: the target AMF indicates this in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
reviewer_note: 금지 대상 새 K_AMF 대신 target AMF를 actor로 선택하고 obligation/positive를 붙임. action에 원문 금지는 남지만 규범 결합 대상이 틀렸고 단순 참조를 exception으로 분류.

source_text_en: When the 5GS supports the Paging Policy Differentiation (PPD) feature, the DSCP value (TOS in IPv4 / TC in IPv6) is set by the application to indicate to the 5GS which Paging Policy should be applied for a certain IP packet.
gold_condition: when the 5GS supports Paging Policy Differentiation, for a particular IP packet
extracted_condition: When the 5GS supports the Paging Policy Differentiation (PPD) feature
gold_action: be selected for application according to the DSCP value set by the application
extracted_action: set the DSCP value (TOS in IPv4 / TC in IPv6) to indicate to the 5GS which Paging Policy should be applied for a certain IP packet
reviewer_note: policy 대신 application을 actor로 선택하고 특정 IP 조건은 action에 이동. unclear로 판단해 생성 보류; 원문의 embedded should 범위 모호성을 반영한 보류임.

source_text_en: If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, the UE may remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached", if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires.
gold_condition: if T3526 was started for rejected S-NSSAI(s) due to the maximum number of UEs being reached and that timer expires
extracted_condition: If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires
gold_action: remove the affected S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI
extracted_action: remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause "S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached"
gold_exception: only S-NSSAI(s) carrying the stated maximum-UE rejection cause
reviewer_note: 최대 UE 수 거절로 시작한 T3526 만료·UE·해당 제거 동작 정확. gold exception 내용은 action의 대상 수식으로 남음. including 대 only 해석 차이는 별도 주의.

source_text_en: The AMF should set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period.
gold_condition: based on the unavailability-period duration and its start
gold_action: set the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer values
extracted_action: set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period
reviewer_note: 두 timer 설정 기준인 unavailability 지속·시작이 condition 대신 action에 모두 들어 있어 정보 손실은 없음.

source_text_en: A special case where the 5GS can act as a sub-network is when the 5GS acts as a TSN network, which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2.
gold_condition: when the 5GS acts as a TSN network
extracted_condition: when the 5GS acts as a TSN network
gold_action: act as a sub-network
extracted_action: can act as a sub-network
gold_exception: this is a special case based on the referenced TSN architecture
extracted_exception: which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2
reviewer_note: 5GS TSN 조건·sub-network 가능성과 참조 아키텍처의 제한을 보존. 예외라기보다 근거지만 gold 슬롯에 대응.

source_text_en: If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to "UE needs to report end of unavailability period", the UE should trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended.
gold_condition: if the AMF omits the Unavailability configuration IE or sets EUPR to require an end-of-period report, when the unavailability duration ends
extracted_condition: If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to "UE needs to report end of unavailability period"
gold_action: trigger registration for mobility registration update
extracted_action: trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended
reviewer_note: IE 미제공/EUPR 지정은 condition에, 기간 종료는 action에 분리됨. 전체 필드 결합하면 두 조건 모두 보존.

source_text_en: However, when the UE operating in dual-registration mode performs an initial registration procedure, it shall take into use a 5G NAS security context and follow the handling of this security context as described in the present specification.
extracted_actor: the UE operating in dual-registration mode
gold_condition: when performing an initial registration procedure
extracted_condition: when the UE operating in dual-registration mode performs an initial registration procedure
gold_action: take a 5G NAS security context into use and handle it as described in the specification
extracted_action: take into use a 5G NAS security context and follow the handling of this security context as described in the present specification
reviewer_note: dual-registration UE initial 절차와 context 사용 개시·규격 처리 의무에 대응하는 구조가 정확.

source_text_en: A new 5G NAS security context may also be created during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover.
gold_condition: during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover
extracted_condition: during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover
gold_action: be created
extracted_action: may also be created
reviewer_note: 새 context·N1→N1 handover·생성 동작 모두 보존; action의 may 중복은 의미 손실 아님.

source_text_en: The UE shall not use the entering of a Non-Allowed Area as a criterion for Cell Reselection, a trigger for PLMN Selection or Domain selection for UE originating sessions or calls.
gold_condition: when entering a Non-Allowed Area
gold_action: use that entry as a criterion for Cell Reselection or as a trigger for PLMN/Domain selection for UE-originating sessions or calls
extracted_action: use the entering of a Non-Allowed Area as a criterion for Cell Reselection, a trigger for PLMN Selection or Domain selection for UE originating sessions or calls
reviewer_note: Non-Allowed 진입이라는 gold 조건이 action 목적어 안에 있고 condition 슬롯은 공란. 전체로는 금지 기준·trigger 세 종류 유지.

source_text_en: The 5G NAS security context which is indicated by an ngKSI can be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure.
gold_actor: 5G NAS security context indicated by an ngKSI
extracted_actor: The 5G NAS security context which is indicated by an ngKSI
gold_condition: when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without new primary authentication and key agreement, or when the AMF initiates security mode control
extracted_condition: when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure
gold_action: be taken into use to establish secure NAS-message exchange
extracted_action: be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages
reviewer_note: ngKSI context·두 조건·보안 NAS 교환 동작은 정확하지만 normative_type을 capability 대신 permission으로 선택.

source_text_en: The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI may be changed during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure.
extracted_actor: The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI
gold_condition: during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure
extracted_condition: during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure
gold_action: be changed
extracted_action: may be changed
reviewer_note: configured/rejected NSSAI 및 두 절차 조건과 변경 동작을 보존.

source_text_en: In the present document, when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI, the UE shall set the ngKSI to the value "no key is available" and consider also the associated keys K AMF or K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key and 5G NAS integrity key invalid (i.e. the 5G NAS security context associated with the ngKSI as no longer valid).
gold_condition: when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI
extracted_condition: when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI
gold_action: set the ngKSI to 'no key is available' and consider the associated K_AMF or K'_AMF, NAS ciphering key, and NAS integrity key invalid
extracted_action: set the ngKSI to the value "no key is available" and consider also the associated keys K AMF or K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key and 5G NAS integrity key invalid (i.e. the 5G NAS security context associated with the ngKSI as no longer valid)
reviewer_note: ngKSI 삭제 조건과 지정 값 설정·연관 키 무효화·context 무효 해석을 정확히 추출.

source_text_en: The network should not move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover, as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location.
gold_condition: as long as the selected PLMN or SNPN remains available at the UE location
extracted_condition: as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location
gold_action: move the UE to another available PLMN or SNPN, including by handover
extracted_action: move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover
reviewer_note: 선택망의 UE 위치 가용 지속 조건과 타 가용망 이동/handover 동작 보존; discouragement 정확.

source_text_en: To enable an emergency call back, the UE should wait for a UE implementation-specific duration of time before requesting the use of MICO mode after the completion of the emergency services.
gold_condition: after completion of emergency services and before requesting MICO mode, to enable an emergency callback
extracted_condition: to enable an emergency call back; after the completion of the emergency services
gold_action: wait for a UE-implementation-specific duration
extracted_action: wait for a UE implementation-specific duration of time before requesting the use of MICO mode
reviewer_note: callback 목적·서비스 종료는 condition에, MICO 요청 전 시점은 action에 분리. 전체 대기 순서는 유지.

source_text_en: The UE can provide the SOR transparent container IE during the registration procedure to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
gold_condition: during the registration procedure
extracted_condition: during the registration procedure
gold_action: provide the SOR transparent container IE to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message
extracted_action: provide the SOR transparent container IE to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message
reviewer_note: UE·등록 절차·SOR IE의 REGISTRATION COMPLETE 전송·network 대상 및 capability가 정확.

source_text_en: The network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) may be indicated by the SMF to the UPF for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure.
gold_condition: for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment
extracted_condition: for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure
gold_action: indicate the N6-interface network instance to the UPF
extracted_action: indicate the network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) to the UPF
reviewer_note: SMF actor, 특정 PDU establishment 조건 및 N6 network instance→UPF 표시 동작이 정확.

source_text_en: To redirect a UE from 5GC to EPC, when the UE sends a Registration Request or Service Request, the AMF sends a Registration Reject or Service Reject with an EMM cause value indicating that the UE should not use 5GC.
gold_condition: when redirecting the UE from 5GC to EPC after a Registration Request or Service Request
extracted_condition: To redirect a UE from 5GC to EPC, when the UE sends a Registration Request or Service Request
gold_action: use 5GC
extracted_action: send a Registration Reject or Service Reject with an EMM cause value indicating that the UE should not use 5GC
gold_exception: the AMF conveys this in the EMM cause of a Registration Reject or Service Reject
reviewer_note: UE의 5GC 비사용 권고 대신 AMF의 Reject 송신을 actor/action으로 잡아 discouragement negative의 결합 대상이 이동. EMM cause 전달 내용은 action 안에 남음.

source_text_en: If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets, it is up to UDSF implementation and deployment to make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data.
gold_actor: NFs authorized to access the data
gold_condition: if a UDSF is shared between NFs outside the same set or between multiple NF sets
extracted_condition: If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets
gold_action: access the data
extracted_action: make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data
gold_exception: only authorized NFs can access the data; enforcement depends on UDSF implementation and deployment
reviewer_note: 원문 전체의 UDSF 보장 책임을 obligation으로 선택. gold의 권한 NF 접근 가능성 target과 불일치하나 책임 독해 자체는 원문에 있음; 단순 정보 삭제와 구별.

source_text_en: A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access shall, after UE registration, support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point.
gold_actor: UE accessing the 5G Core Network over non-3GPP access
extracted_actor: A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access
gold_condition: after UE registration
extracted_condition: after UE registration
gold_action: support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point
extracted_action: support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point
reviewer_note: non-3GPP UE·등록 이후·N1 core signalling 지원 동작과 obligation이 정확.

source_text_en: If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]; the AMF should not immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure.
gold_condition: if the UE is authorized for V2X communication over PC5 by the stated capability bits and subscription context
extracted_condition: If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to "V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to "V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]
gold_action: immediately release the NAS signalling connection after registration completes
extracted_action: immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure
reviewer_note: PC5 V2X capability 두 비트 대안·현재/저장 맥락·UDM 가입정보 결합 및 AMF 즉시 해제 동작을 상세히 보존.

source_text_en: In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF, is invalid, the UE shall delete the ngKSI.
gold_condition: during the initial registration procedure when K_AUSF is invalid
extracted_condition: In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF is invalid
gold_action: delete the ngKSI
extracted_action: delete the ngKSI
reviewer_note: 초기 등록 K_AUSF invalid 조건과 UE ngKSI 삭제 동작·의무를 보존.

source_text_en: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane shall only use service-based interfaces for their interactions.
gold_actor: network functions within the 5GC Control Plane
extracted_actor: Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane
gold_condition: for interactions between those network functions
gold_action: use service-based interfaces
extracted_action: only use service-based interfaces for their interactions
gold_exception: only service-based interfaces are permitted
reviewer_note: NF 상호작용 조건과 SBI only 제한이 모두 action에 있음. condition/exception 슬롯은 비었으나 결합 의미는 유지.

source_text_en: The emergency PDU session shall not be released.
gold_action: be released
extracted_action: be released
reviewer_note: emergency PDU release 금지의 대상·동작을 정확히 추출.

source_text_en: A non-3GPP access network may advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity (e.g. "5G connectivity").
gold_action: advertise supported PLMNs or SNPNs and the supported trusted-connectivity type
extracted_action: advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity
gold_exception: only PLMNs or SNPNs for which trusted connectivity is supported
reviewer_note: 지원 망 only 제한은 action에 보존. exception에 실제 예외 대신 5G connectivity 예시를 넣어 역할 분류는 부정확하나 e.g. 표식으로 예시임을 유지.

source_text_en: UEs that are not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking may be served by entities not dedicated for interworking, i.e. by either by PGW or SMF/UPF.
gold_actor: UEs not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking
extracted_actor: UEs that are not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking
gold_condition: when not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking
gold_action: be served by a PGW or by an SMF/UPF not dedicated to interworking
extracted_action: be served by entities not dedicated for interworking, i.e. by either PGW or SMF/UPF
reviewer_note: 비interworking 조건이 actor 수식에 보존되어 있고 PGW/SMF-UPF 비전용 서비스 동작도 정확.

source_text_en: However, each SMF may also have the capability to control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session.
gold_condition: within a PDU Session
gold_action: control both a local UPF and a central UPF
extracted_action: have the capability to control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session
reviewer_note: 한 session 조건이 action에 이동. 능력 보유 구조 자체는 원문에 있으나 may 선택성을 capability로 단일 분류하여 gold permission과 불일치.

source_text_en: This current 5G NAS security context can be of type native or mapped, i.e. originating from a native 5G NAS security context or mapped 5G NAS security context.
gold_action: be either native or mapped
extracted_action: can be of type native or mapped, i.e. originating from a native 5G NAS security context or mapped 5G NAS security context
reviewer_note: 현재 context의 native/mapped 유형 및 각각 origin을 보존.

source_text_en: When AMF allocates registration area for UE registered for Disaster Roaming service as specified in clause 5.40.4, AMF shall only consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition.
gold_condition: when allocating a registration area for a UE registered for Disaster Roaming service
extracted_condition: UE registered for Disaster Roaming service as specified in clause 5.40.4
gold_action: consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition
extracted_action: only consider TAIs covering the area with the Disaster Condition when allocating registration area
gold_exception: only TAIs covering the Disaster Condition area
reviewer_note: Disaster Roaming UE는 condition에, 영역 할당 시점과 Disaster Condition TAI only는 action에 존재. 슬롯 경계만 다름.

source_text_en: The architecture does not require the DS-TT functionality to be supported in the device nor require the user plane NWTT functionality to be supported in the UPF, however, it can co-exist with such functions.
extracted_actor: DS-TT functionality in the device; user plane NWTT functionality in the UPF
gold_condition: when DS-TT in the device or NW-TT in the UPF is present
gold_action: co-exist with DS-TT and NW-TT functions
extracted_action: can co-exist with such functions
gold_exception: the architecture does not require those functions to be supported
extracted_exception: The architecture does not require DS-TT functionality to be supported in the device nor require user plane NWTT functionality to be supported in the UPF
reviewer_note: architecture 대신 DS-TT/NW-TT 기능을 actor로 추출하여 공존의 주체를 바꿈. condition은 없고 architecture 비필수성은 exception에 있으나 올바른 actor-action 결합을 복원하지 못함.

source_text_en: Each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR, via Nudr, shall be able to add, modify, update or delete only the data it is authorised to change.
gold_actor: each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR via Nudr
extracted_actor: Each NF Service Consumer accessing the UDR, via Nudr
gold_condition: when accessing the UDR via Nudr
gold_action: add, modify, update, or delete data
extracted_action: be able to add, modify, update or delete only the data it is authorised to change
gold_exception: only data that the NF Service Consumer is authorized to change
reviewer_note: UDR/Nudr는 actor, 권한 데이터 only는 action에 보존. shall be able to의 의무를 capability로 분류해 규범 강도는 잘못됨.

source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the following: a) requests for emergency services; b) requests for emergency services fallback; c) requests from UEs configured for high priority access in selected PLMN or SNPN; d) DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message; e) requests for mobile terminated services, triggered by paging or a notification procedure; f) requests for initial registration or mobility and periodic registration update, when emergency is indicated by lower layers; and g) requests for mobility registration update when the UE is reporting unavailability information due to discontinuous coverage.
gold_condition: during 5GMM signalling congestion control
gold_action: reject emergency, emergency-fallback, high-priority, deregistration, mobile-terminated, emergency-indicated registration, or discontinuous-coverage update requests listed in the sentence
extracted_action: reject the following: a) requests for emergency services; b) requests for emergency services fallback; c) requests from UEs configured for high priority access in selected PLMN or SNPN; d) DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message; e) requests for mobile terminated services, triggered by paging or a notification procedure; f) requests for initial registration or mobility and periodic registration update, when emergency is indicated by lower layers; and g) requests for mobility registration update when the UE is reporting unavailability information due to discontinuous coverage
gold_exception: the non-rejection recommendation is limited to the seven listed request classes
reviewer_note: 7종과 한계는 action에 모두 있지만 congestion 조건은 어떤 추출 필드에도 없음. 이는 추출 입력 원문에도 없고 질문/gold 및 상위 조항에만 있어 모델이 추정해 채우면 안 되는 맥락 결손.

source_text_en: A UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network of a PLMN/SNPN over a 3GPP access and a non-3GPP access shall be served by a single AMF in this 5G Core Network.
gold_actor: UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network over 3GPP and non-3GPP access
extracted_actor: A UE simultaneously connected to the same 5G Core Network of a PLMN/SNPN over a 3GPP access and a non-3GPP access
gold_action: be served by a single AMF in that 5G Core Network
extracted_action: be served by a single AMF in this 5G Core Network

source_text_en: If the UE does not indicate preference for MICO mode during Registration procedure, the AMF shall not activate MICO mode for this UE.

extracted_condition: If the UE does not indicate preference for MICO mode during Registration procedure

source_text_en: In order to enforce all primary RAT restrictions, the related RAT has to be deployed in different Tracking Area Codes and the subscriber shall not be allowed to access the network in TAs using the particular RAT.

extracted_action: be used for Untrusted or Trusted non-3GPP access

source_text_en: If the disabling of N1 mode capability for 3GPP access was due to no network slices available, the UE should memorize the identity of the PLMN or SNPN where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices or the list of SNPNs where N1 mode is disabled due to no available network slices, respectively.

source_text_en: Once the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the receiving 5GMM entity in the UE shall not process any NAS signalling messages unless they have been successfully integrity checked by the NAS.

source_text_en: Not all events can be subscribed to UPF directly.

gold_action: be subscribed to the UPF directly
extracted_action: be subscribed to UPF directly

gold_condition: when connected to 5GS/NR
extracted_condition: when connected to 5GS/NR

extracted_action: send its E-UTRA connected to 5GC and E-UTRAN radio capabilities to NR access

extracted_exception: to avoid being handed over to 5GC-connected E-UTRA or to E-UTRAN
reviewer_note: dual-registered UE·5GS/NR 조건·두 capability NR 송신과 handover 회피 목적 모두 보존.

source_text_en: If the UE does not include a 5G-GUTI, the SUCI shall be used for the new registration.

extracted_condition: If the UE does not include a 5G-GUTI

extracted_action: be used for the new registration

source_text_en: To avoid paging in the entire PLMN, when the AMF allocates the Active Time the AMF should not allocate "all PLMN" registration area to the UE.

source_text_en: Before security can be activated, the AMF and the UE need to establish a 5G NAS security context.

extracted_condition: Before security can be activated

extracted_action: need to establish a 5G NAS security context

source_text_en: As described in subclause 4.8 in order to interwork with E-UTRAN connected to EPC, the UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode can operate in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode.
gold_actor: UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode
extracted_actor: the UE supporting both S1 mode and N1 mode
gold_condition: for interworking with E-UTRAN connected to EPC
extracted_condition: in order to interwork with E-UTRAN connected to EPC

reviewer_note: S1/N1 지원 UE·EPC E-UTRAN interworking·single/dual mode 운용 구조와 capability 유지.

source_text_en: The default configured NSSAI may be changed by sending a UE parameters update transparent container to the UE during the NAS transport procedure.

extracted_condition: during the NAS transport procedure

extracted_action: change the default configured NSSAI by sending a UE parameters update transparent container
reviewer_note: container를 수신하는 UE를 변경 주체로 오인. action은 UE가 container를 송신하는 것으로 읽히고 원문의 to UE 방향도 누락.

source_text_en: When the UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services and has no current EPS security context, the AMF shall set 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS security algorithms in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE.
gold_condition: when a single-registration-mode UE in a network supporting N26 has an emergency-bearer PDN connection and no current EPS security context
extracted_condition: the UE operating in single-registration mode in a network supporting N26 interface has a PDN connection for emergency bearer services and has no current EPS security context

extracted_action: set 5G-IA0 and 5G-EA0 as the selected 5G NAS security algorithms in the S1 mode to N1 mode NAS transparent container IE
reviewer_note: AMF·N26/single/emergencyPDN/noEPS 네 조건 및 지정 IE 두 algorithm 설정 구조 정확.

source_text_en: When a N5CW device performs an EAP-based access authentication procedure to connect to a trusted WLAN access network, the N5CW device may simultaneously be registered to a 5GC of a PLMN or SNPN.

extracted_condition: When the N5CW device performs an EAP-based access authentication procedure to connect to a trusted WLAN access network

extracted_action: be simultaneously registered to a 5GC of a PLMN or SNPN
reviewer_note: N5CW·trusted WLAN EAP 인증 조건·PLMN/SNPN 5GC 동시 등록 상태·permission 유지.

source_text_en: The Registration Area of a UE in the Non-Allowed Area should consist of a set of TAs which belongs to a NonAllowed Area of the UE.
gold_actor: Registration Area of a UE in a Non-Allowed Area
extracted_actor: The Registration Area of a UE in the Non-Allowed Area

reviewer_note: UE의 Non-Allowed 위치 조건이 actor 수식에 있고 해당 TA 집합 구성 action은 정확.

source_text_en: The number of S-NSSAIs included in the partially allowed NSSAI or the partially rejected NSSAI shall not exceed 7.
gold_actor: number of S-NSSAIs in the partially allowed NSSAI or partially rejected NSSAI
extracted_actor: The number of S-NSSAIs included in the partially allowed NSSAI or the partially rejected NSSAI

extracted_action: exceed 7

source_text_en: If the NG-RAN node takes a decision to initiate UAC because of the reception of the N2 interface OVERLOAD START messages, the NG-RAN should only initiate such procedure if all the AMFs relevant to the request contained in the OVERLOAD START message and connected to this NG-RAN node request to restrict the load for UEs that access the network.
gold_condition: if it decides to initiate UAC after receiving N2 OVERLOAD START messages
extracted_condition: If the NG-RAN node takes a decision to initiate UAC because of the reception of the N2 interface OVERLOAD START messages

gold_exception: only if all relevant connected AMFs named by the request ask to restrict load for accessing UEs
reviewer_note: UAC 결정 계기 condition 및 모든 관련 연결 AMF 요청 only-if가 action에 보존. exception 공란이지만 한계 유지.

source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.
gold_condition: when handling the request and the UE
gold_action: reject the request or deregister the UE
extracted_action: reject the request or deregister the UE
gold_exception: unless sufficiently accurate location information shows that the UE is in an area where the PLMN may not operate
extracted_exception: unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate
reviewer_note: 요청·UE 처리라는 gold 조건은 reject/deregister action에 내포. 정확한 위치로 운용 금지 지역 확인하는 unless 예외 유지.

source_text_en: The AMF shall define an ngKSI for the newly derived K'AMF key such that the value field is taken from the eKSI of the KASME key and the type field is set to indicate a mapped security context and associate this ngKSI with the newly created mapped 5G NAS security context.
gold_condition: for the newly derived K'_AMF key
extracted_condition: for the newly derived K'AMF key

extracted_action: define an ngKSI such that the value field is taken from the eKSI of the KASME key and the type field is set to indicate a mapped security context and associate this ngKSI with the newly created mapped 5G NAS security context
reviewer_note: 새 K'AMF 조건 및 eKSI value/mapped type/ngKSI-context 연결의 AMF 의무 구조 정확.

source_text_en: If the UE is performing registration over one access and intends to perform registration over the other access in the same PLMN (e.g. the 3GPP access and the selected N3IWF, TNGF or W-AGF are located in the same PLMN), the UE shall not initiate the registration over the other access until the Registration procedure over first access is completed.
gold_condition: when already registering over one access and intending to register over the other access in the same PLMN
extracted_condition: If the UE is performing registration over one access and intends to perform registration over the other access in the same PLMN (e.g. the 3GPP access and the selected N3IWF, TNGF or W-AGF are located in the same PLMN)

extracted_action: initiate the registration over the other access

extracted_exception: until the Registration procedure over first access is completed
reviewer_note: 같은 PLMN의 두 access 등록 조건과 첫 절차 완료까지 다른 등록 금지 결합 유지. exception의 until은 negative 라벨과 함께 해석.

source_text_en: The UE should not request to join a multicast MBS session for local MBS service if neither current TAI nor CGI of the current cell is part of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session, if the UE has valid information of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session.
gold_condition: if the UE has valid MBS service-area information and neither the current TAI nor current-cell CGI is in the multicast session service area
extracted_condition: the UE has valid information of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session; neither current TAI nor CGI of the current cell is part of the MBS service area(s) of the multicast MBS session
gold_action: request to join the multicast MBS session for local MBS service
extracted_action: request to join a multicast MBS session for local MBS service
reviewer_note: 유효 MBS 정보와 neither TAI nor CGI 영역 포함 조건·local multicast join 동작·비권고 보존.

source_text_en: In addition, the HPLMN may configure a UE with a single default configured NSSAI and consider the default configured NSSAI as valid in a PLMN for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI.
gold_condition: in a PLMN for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI
extracted_condition: for which the UE has neither a configured NSSAI nor an allowed NSSAI

extracted_action: configure a UE with a single default configured NSSAI and consider the default configured NSSAI as valid in a PLMN

reviewer_note: HPLMN·neither configured nor allowed 조건과 default 구성/PLMN 유효 간주 동작 정확. single 한계는 action에 남으며 조건의 for which는 action의 PLMN에 연결됨.

source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.

extracted_action: store the allowed NSSAI(s) in a non-volatile memory

reviewer_note: gold의 stored NSSAI 수동 주체 대신 저장하는 ME를 actor로 정규화. actor 슬롯은 다르지만 장소 ME와 저장 대상·동작·Annex C가 결합해 원문 의미는 유지.

source_text_en: For the case when the UE has an emergency PDU session and integrity check fails, the AMF may skip the authentication procedure even if no 5G NAS security context is available and proceed directly to the execution of the security mode control procedure as specified in subclause 5.4.2.

extracted_condition: when the UE has an emergency PDU session and integrity check fails

extracted_action: skip the authentication procedure and proceed directly to the execution of the security mode control procedure as specified in subclause 5.4.2

extracted_action: be transmitted in an information element in the 5GMM transport messages
reviewer_note: 5GMM transport 경로 조건이 action 안에 있어 정보 손실 없음; capability와 전달 IE 위치 정확.
